metadata.value: Depth completion: generate dense depth predictions from sparse and irregular point clouds using LiDAR points with monocular RGB guidance and uncertainty
metadata.normalized_value: Depth completion: generate dense depth predictions from sparse and irregular point clouds using LiDAR points with monocular RGB guidance and uncertainty
metadata.evidence: The goal of the depth completion task is to generate dense depth predictions from sparse and irregular point clouds. This project makes use of uncertainty to combine multiple sensor data in order to generate accurate depth predictions. Mapped lidar points together with RGB images (monocular) are used in this framework.
metadata.reason: Defines the scientific task and method inputs, key for indexing and search.
